2610.09769.title: From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving
2610.09769.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems extracted from four sets of papers, solving about 200 open problems. One experiment used papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science. There, we answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by their authors.
2610.09769.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在數學研究中越來越發揮作用，而進展往往依賴於高效的證明搜尋、漸進的改進和仔細的驗證。<lb/>我們描述了Bolzano，一個多代理的開源系統，它使用並行證明代理和驗證代理，並維持一個人類可讀的研究狀態。<lb/>在專家選擇的問題上進行的初步手動使用產生了8個結果，其證明已由領域專家檢查。<lb/>受到這些案例研究的激勵，我們在沒有問題特定人類指導的情況下運行了Bolzano，處理了約3,800個從四組論文中提取的開放問題，解決了約200個開放問題。<lb/>一個實驗使用了被STOC 2026接受的論文，這是一個在理論計算機科學領域的頂級會議。<lb/>在那裡，我們回答了論文中提出的四個問題，這得到了其作者的確認。
